reasons: Gifts are used on a second home at 90% LTV, so 5% ($16,250) must come from the borrower's own funds; they have $13,700.

final_answer:
DTI 33.4% (B3-6-02). LTV 90%. Funds to close $39,179; available $13,700 + $33,627 gift = $47,327. Reserves after close ≈3.6 months, meets 2-month second-home requirement (B3-4.1-01). Gift from parent with letter is acceptable (B3-4.3-04). However, for second home with LTV >80%, borrower must contribute ≥5% of property value ($16,250) from own funds (B3-4.3-04). Borrower has only $13,700 own funds — short $2,550. Cannot be cured by condition (no additional funds allowed).

DECISION: decline
RULES: B3-4.3-04
